notes.title: First Devlog is live!
notes.content:
Hello hello!

I'm very happy to share some of the latest updates I've been working on. This week, we released the first Game Devlog on YouTube!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45214775/a25faf29b8df5c158cf0322bf11fd070d51c4d8d.png[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TeQ9nQcSx-U&t=2s

The idea of ​​this content is to keep the development transparent and also collect feedback and ideas from all of you on how to evolve Umbra Lumen!

So now you know, come be a part of our community and make the game even more like you!
